fees.source: https://www.nps.gov/indu/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm ('$25.00 per night camping fee') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/258887/rates (2026 RV Nonelectric $25) + https://www.nps.gov/indu/planyourvisit/fees.htm ('Private Vehicle $25.00', 7-day; rec.gov: 'A valid entrance pass or receipt is required for all visitors'), read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: https://www.nps.gov/indu/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm ('No electric or water hookups at individual sites'); recreation.gov catalog types every RV site RV NONELECTRIC, read 2026-10-31

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/258887 ('66 campsites') and the RIDB catalog (53 RV + 13 tent-only, 4 of the RV sites Pull-through), read 2026-10-31

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/indu/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm ('Campground Open Dates: April 1 through November 1'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: All sites reservable six months ahead of check-in; sites become reservable November 15 for the following season. Check-out noon; a new arrival cannot occupy a site before noon unless it is vacant.

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/indu/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/258887 ('Stays are limited to 14 days in a 30-day period'), read 2026-10-31

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/indu/planyourvisit/campgrounds.htm (restrooms and showers in each loop, RV dump station, potable water in each loop) + NPS campgrounds API (Flush Toilets), read 2026-10-31

discounts.source: NPS campgrounds API, parkCode indu (Access Pass and Senior Pass $12.50 per night), read 2026-10-31

summary: $25, no hookups, reservable on rec.gov confirmed; entrance fee, season Apr 1-Nov 1, 66 sites, 14-night limit, facilities and the pass discount added. Pin is good. All 53 RV sites have driveways of 26 ft or more; max_rig_ft left out because rec.gov posts driveways only (top values 95 and 99 ft look unreliable) and says some sites are length-limited without saying which.
flags: ENTRANCE FEE: every camper also needs the park's entrance pass, $25 per vehicle for 7 days (rec.gov notice + NPS fees page), on top of $25 a night. Separately recorded as fees.entrance, not added to the base.
